terms.definition: The carrier's customer relationship with exactly one insured or prospective insured organization, with at most one designated parent account.
The lifecycle state of an account in the teaching vocabulary: CURRENT means not closed.
Account status CLOSED in the teaching vocabulary (ADR-0070 section 2).
Account status CURRENT in the teaching vocabulary (ADR-0070 section 2).
The one organization the account is the customer relationship with; the link never changes.
The account designated as this account's parent for roll-up; never computed from ownership.
The account's lifecycle status at a valid and known time; unknown status is incomplete, not closed.
A binding arrangement between parties; insurance policies and programs are agreements defined by insurance modules.
A quantity with a unit or currency; money is an amount with a currency and a basis.
An attributable choice made by a party or principal under stated authority.
A source document whose versions are parsed once and retained as immutable evidence.
Something that happens at a point in time at its stated granularity.
A value that identifies a thing within a named issuing scheme.
An observed or reported quantity with its unit, method and observation time.
An identified organization. Broker, carrier, MGA and insured are roles it plays in a scope, not kinds of organization.
Inverse of parent organization; derived, never stored as a slot.
A place at which the organization operates during the valid period.
The organization directly above this one in its hierarchy; the hierarchy has no fixed depth.
A recorded ownership of one organization by a party with a percentage; majority is computed, never stored.
The organization the ownership interest is in.
The party holding the ownership interest.
The recorded percentage of the owned organization held, greater than 0 and at most 100.
A person or an organization capable of participating in a scoped insurance relationship.
An individual human party; a role played in insurance does not make the person an application principal.
The organization or branch that employs the person; separate from any role the person plays.
A location such as an office, premises or yard at which an organization operates; operating there does not make it insured property.
A sequence of activities with lifecycle states, defined in detail by later process modules.
A function a party performs within a scope; roles describe who does what and grant nothing by themselves.
A party playing a role kind in a scope, optionally acting for an organization, valid over a period.
The organization or branch a person represents in this role.
The trusted source that confirmed the assignment; data only, it grants nothing.
A coverage part of a policy term that narrows a policy-term role; insurance modules narrow the range.
The party filling the role during the valid period.
The kind of role assigned; fixed for the life of the assignment.
The account, policy term or submission the assignment applies to; fixed for the life of the assignment.
The open vocabulary of role kinds a role assignment can name.
The account contact role kind (ADR-0070 section 4); confers no access by itself.
The additional insured role kind (ADR-0070 section 4); confers no access by itself.
The additional named insured role kind (ADR-0070 section 4); confers no access by itself.
The broker contact role kind (ADR-0070 section 4); confers no access by itself.
The broker of record role kind (ADR-0070 section 4); confers no access by itself.
The distribution contact role kind (ADR-0070 section 4); confers no access by itself.
The first named insured role kind (ADR-0070 section 4); confers no access by itself.
The marketing representative role kind (ADR-0070 section 4); confers no access by itself.
The operations contact role kind (ADR-0070 section 4); confers no access by itself.
The organization contact role kind (ADR-0070 section 4); confers no access by itself.
The placement broker role kind (ADR-0070 section 4); confers no access by itself.
The risk manager role kind (ADR-0070 section 4); confers no access by itself.
The underwriter role kind (ADR-0070 section 4); confers no access by itself.
The underwriting assistant role kind (ADR-0070 section 4); confers no access by itself.
The thing a role assignment applies to. Account is a role scope; insurance modules add policy-term and submission scopes.
The root of every foundation class; anything the Brain can describe with evidence.
A span of time with a start and an end bound at stated granularities.
